title: feat(xdr): define a versioned JSON schema for decoded values
problem: Decoded JSON currently mirrors the crate's serde shape and is documented as unstable.
why: A stable, versioned schema is required for CI diffs and downstream tooling.
context: The README and PROJECT_STATUS explicitly call the shape unstable.
scope: Define a versioned schema for SCVal, envelope, and event output
Emit a schema version field and document migration
guidance: Prefer additive change; keep the raw encoding available behind a flag.
docs: Add docs/XDR.md and docs/SCVAL.md schema sections.
dod: Merged with tests passing and CI green.

title: feat(security): make XDR decode limits configurable and strict
problem: Decoding uses a permissive limit, so very large inputs are accepted.
why: Bounded decoding protects against resource exhaustion on untrusted input.
context: `Limits::none()` is used today.
scope: Add configurable depth/size limits
Return a structured error when exceeded
out_of_scope: Changing the public function signatures unnecessarily.
guidance: Provide a safe default and allow raising it explicitly.
dod: Merged with tests passing and CI green.

title: feat(xdr): add strict encode helpers from JSON to XDR
problem: The toolkit can decode but not encode, limiting round-trip workflows and fixtures creation.
why: Encoding enables fixture generation and diffing.
context: `stellar-xdr` provides `WriteXdr`.
scope: Encode SCVal/envelope/event from a documented input to base64 XDR
Reject invalid input with structured errors
guidance: Never accept ambiguous input; validate strictly.
security: Encoding untrusted input must not panic.
dod: Merged with tests passing and CI green.

title: feat(cli): add batch decoding from files and directories
problem: Decoding is one input at a time, which is tedious for many values.
why: Batch decoding supports real workflows and CI artifacts.
context: CLI commands accept a single base64 argument.
scope: Accept `--input-file` with one value per line
Produce aggregated JSON, rejecting traversal paths
guidance: Bound total input size and number of entries.
tests: CLI test with a small file
dod: Merged with tests passing and CI green.

title: test(xdr): add golden fixtures for XDR decoding
problem: There are no committed fixtures; correctness relies on self-generated round trips.
why: External golden fixtures catch schema drift that round trips cannot.
context: Fixtures directory exists but is empty.
scope: Commit small, human-documented fixtures with expected findings-free JSON
Load and assert in tests
guidance: Generate fixtures with DevKit itself and record provenance.
acceptance: Fixtures load and are asserted in CI
security: Fixtures must contain no secrets or real keys.
dod: Merged with tests passing and CI green.

title: feat(testing): add a fixture loader and schema
problem: There is no shared way to describe and load fixtures for RPC responses and XDR values.
why: A fixture system is the foundation for deterministic testing of network-facing tools.
context: A mock transport exists but fixtures are inlined in tests.
scope: Define a fixture directory schema
Load fixtures by name with validation
guidance: Keep fixtures small and reviewable; never include secrets.
acceptance: Fixtures load by name and are validated
security: Reject fixtures that escape the fixture root.
dod: Merged with tests passing and CI green.

title: feat(testing): add mock RPC network scenarios
problem: `MockTransport` returns queued values but cannot express realistic scenario sequences.
why: Scenario-based mocks make RPC tooling testable end to end without a network.
context: MockTransport records calls and returns queued responses.
scope: Add named scenarios (healthy node, stale node, rate-limited, malformed)
Expose them through the fixture loader
guidance: Deterministic and offline only.
dod: Merged with tests passing and CI green.

title: test(xdr): add property-based round-trip tests
problem: Round-trip tests cover a few hand-picked values only.
why: Property tests catch edge cases across the value space.
context: Encode helpers and decode functions exist.
scope: Add property tests asserting decode(encode(v)) == v for a generator of SCVal/envelope values
out_of_scope: Exhaustive coverage of every XDR type.
guidance: Keep generators bounded and deterministic.
acceptance: Properties pass locally and in CI
security: Generators must not allocate unbounded memory.
dod: Merged with tests passing and CI green.

title: test(security): add a fuzz target for XDR and SCVal decoding
problem: Decoding is covered by examples, not coverage-guided fuzzing.
why: Fuzzing finds panics and pathological inputs that examples miss.
context: All decoded input is untrusted.
scope: Add a `fuzz/` crate with targets for SCVal, envelope, and event decoding
Run a bounded smoke fuzz in CI on a schedule
out_of_scope: Fuzzing the CLI argument parser (separate issue).
guidance: Use `cargo-fuzz`; no filesystem access in targets.
acceptance: No panics found in a bounded run
docs: Document how to run the fuzzer.
dod: Merged with a scheduled job.

title: feat(security): harden the HTTP transport against SSRF and unsafe redirects
problem: A live transport will follow redirects and resolve DNS; without controls this risks SSRF.
why: Endpoint handling is the toolkit's primary network attack surface.
context: Endpoint validation exists but transport behavior does not.
scope: Reject redirects to non-allowlisted hosts
Block link-local and private ranges for remote endpoints
Re-validate the final URL
guidance: Fail closed; document the policy.
acceptance: Redirect and private-range requests are refused
security: Core SSRF mitigation; requires focused review.
dod: Merged with tests passing and CI green.

title: feat(security): redact secrets in logs and output
problem: Future logging and error paths could leak URLs with credentials or environment values.
why: Secret leakage in logs is a common and damaging mistake.
context: No logging exists yet, so now is the time to define a redaction pass.
scope: Add a redaction helper and use it in all log/error formatting
Test with token-like inputs
guidance: Blacklist common token patterns and userinfo in URLs.
dod: Merged with tests passing and CI green.

title: feat(sarif): emit SARIF for security findings
problem: Security analysis results have no standard machine format for code scanning.
why: SARIF enables GitHub code scanning and many CI dashboards.
context: Security analysis is planned; SARIF is its reporting layer.
scope: Produce SARIF 2.1.0 with stable rule ids, locations, severity mapping, and remediation
Validate structurally in tests
guidance: Emit only findings backed by real evidence.
acceptance: Valid SARIF produced and parsed in tests
dod: Merged with tests passing and CI green.

title: feat(github): add a composite Action to run DevKit checks
problem: There is no packaged way to use DevKit in a workflow.
why: An Action is the standard distribution channel for CI tooling.
context: The repository has CI but no `action.yml`.
scope: Add `action.yml` with documented inputs/outputs and least-privilege defaults
Test it against this repository
guidance: Do not request unnecessary permissions; document each.
acceptance: Action runs in CI and produces output
tests: A workflow that uses the Action
security: Least privilege; handle fork PRs safely.
dod: Merged and verified in CI.

title: feat(github): add changed-file pull-request analysis workflow
problem: CI runs everything on every change; there is no changed-file analysis.
why: Focused PR analysis is faster and more useful to reviewers.
context: CI exists; PR analysis does not.
scope: Add a workflow that computes changed files and runs the appropriate checks
Guard SARIF upload for forks
guidance: Keep permissions minimal.
dod: Merged and verified.

title: feat(contracts): inspect WASM contract specs via soroban-spec
problem: There is no contract inspection; developers must use other tools.
why: Read-only spec inspection is a high-value developer workflow.
context: `soroban-spec` 28.0.0 provides spec utilities.
scope: Extract and print contract spec entries from a WASM file
Clearly separate confirmed facts from inference
guidance: Never execute WASM; only parse metadata.
acceptance: Spec entries are extracted from a fixture WASM
Unavailable data is reported as unavailable
security: Treat WASM as untrusted; bound parsing.
dod: Merged with tests passing and CI green.

title: feat(transactions): add an envelope summary command
problem: Envelope decoding returns full XDR JSON but no concise summary.
why: A summary is what developers usually want first.
context: Envelope decoding is implemented.
scope: Summarize source, fee, operation count, and network-agnostic fields
Keep the full JSON available
guidance: Only report fields that are present; never infer.
dod: Merged with tests passing and CI green.

title: feat(events): add a typed getEvents model with pagination
problem: Events are fetched as raw JSON with no pagination support.
why: Event tooling is central to contract monitoring.
context: `getEvents` passthrough exists; the model and pagination do not.
scope: Model event responses and decode event XDR
Support cursor-based pagination with explicit bounds
out_of_scope: Long-term indexing (RPC retains a bounded window).
guidance: Respect the RPC retention window; document it.
security: Bound number of pages and response size.
dod: Merged with tests passing and CI green.

title: perf(observability): benchmark decode throughput
problem: Decode performance is unmeasured.
why: Measurement is required before any optimization or claim.
context: No benchmarks exist.
scope: Add a dependency-free benchmark for SCVal/envelope decoding
Document results and methodology
guidance: Report measured numbers only.
dod: Merged and documented.

title: ci(release): build and attach cross-platform release binaries
problem: Releases would require users to build from source.
why: Prebuilt binaries lower the barrier to adoption.
context: No release workflow exists.
scope: Add a tagged-release workflow building Linux, macOS, and Windows binaries with checksums
guidance: Verify artifacts before upload.
acceptance: A release produces artifacts with checksums
dod: Merged and verified on a release.

title: feat(cli): add shell completion generation
problem: There are no shell completions.
why: Completions improve day-to-day usability.
context: The CLI uses clap derive.
scope: Add a hidden `completions <shell>` command for bash, zsh, fish, PowerShell
guidance: Use `clap_complete`.
dod: Merged with tests passing and CI green.

title: ci(deps): configure automated dependency updates
problem: Dependencies are updated manually.
why: Automated updates surface advisories and drift early.
context: The project depends on the fast-moving stellar-xdr line.
scope: Add Dependabot configuration for Cargo and GitHub Actions, grouped weekly
guidance: Group patch updates to reduce noise.
acceptance: Configuration merged and update PRs appear
dod: Merged.

title: feat(cli): add config init, show, and validate subcommands
problem: Once configuration exists, users need a way to create and validate it.
why: Discoverable configuration reduces misconfiguration.
context: A configuration system is planned.
scope: Add `config init`, `config show`, and `config validate`
guidance: Never overwrite without an explicit flag.
acceptance: All three subcommands documented and tested
security: Never write outside the target directory.
dod: Merged with tests passing and CI green.

title: test(cli): assert the exit-code contract
problem: Exit codes are documented but not asserted end to end.
why: Exit codes are API for CI; they must not regress silently.
context: Exit codes 0/2/3 are documented in docs/CLI.md.
scope: Add CLI tests asserting each documented exit code
guidance: Cover success, usage error, and decode error.
dod: Merged with tests passing and CI green.

title: ci(msrv): pin and test a minimum supported Rust version
problem: No MSRV is declared or tested.
why: A tested MSRV is a concrete compatibility promise.
context: The compatibility policy is unstated.
scope: Choose and test an MSRV, declare `rust-version`, and update docs
guidance: Verify all dependencies build on that toolchain.
dod: Merged with tests passing and CI green.
